rules.statement: The Supreme Court found that the appellant's story about the transfer deed and will was false due to documentary evidence showing Selvadurai, a key witness, was in Vavuniya at the time.
rules.supporting_quote: "These documents D.1, D.2, D.3, D.4 and D.7 are letters and postcards written by Selvadurai to the appellant and other persons and their dates, contents and postmarks show, beyond reasonable doubt, that at the time when, according to the appellant's evidence, Selvadurai was taking part in this curious nocturnal expedition at Valvettiturai he was in fact at a place called Vavuniya, some eighty miles away."
